newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean inspection destinations - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean inspection destinations - USDA.

text.p: The 27.383 million bushels of U.S. soybeans inspected for export in the week ended Oct 17 were for the following destinations (1,000 bushels):

Mississippi River to Barbados 54; Taiwan 320; Colombia 255; Germany 2,453; Japan 1,985; South Korea 2,117; Mexico 661; Netherlands 2,365; Philippines 404; Spain 1,990; Thailand 1,746. East Gulf to Mexico 463.
Puget Sound to Taiwan 2,083; Malaysia 1,010; Thailand 1,102. Interior to Mexico 2,680.
